March 2026

Field Notes: The Peat Bogs of Caithness

We rose before dawn and walked three miles into the Flow Country with nothing but a headlamp and rubber boots. The bog at this hour is not quiet — it breathes, softly, releasing something ancient and green and faintly sweet.

Read dispatch →

January 2026

On the Habit of Silence: Distilling at Dawn

The copper still takes forty minutes to warm. In that time, Alasdair reads, and I watch the first light come over the hill. There is a quality to this particular stillness that no synthetic accord has ever captured.

Moth & Meridian
Est. Caithness, 2011

Small-batch botanical perfumery from the Scottish Highlands. Every fragrance is wild-sourced, copper-distilled, and bottled by hand in an edition of three hundred.
